The '''Artesian space collage''' was an art form that originated on the planet [[Artesia]]<ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|I|43|Artesian space collage}}</ref> from the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Artesia system/Legends|Artesia system]]</ref> In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], the mechanic [[Cole Fardreamer]] compared the appearance of the droid [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], when various tools were hanging from him, to a part of an Artesian space collage.<ref name="NR">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref>
